_about: Pattern lists of hooks/git_commit_check.py, read once by its patterns() on the commit path. log_scan_extensions/env_log_patterns: code files whose added lines must not log the environment itself (check_security). secret_scan_extensions/commit_only_patterns: code files scanned for the secret shapes the shared detector (shared/scrub.secret_kind) does not cover, as [regex, description] pairs, matched case-insensitively (check_hardcoded_secrets).
